resolved.title: 导入 Import
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Imports[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Each package has exported names, which you can access after importing them.

In [b]Go[/b], a name is exported if it begins with a [b]capital letter[/b].
You can access the exported names using the package name, a dot, and the exported name.

In our case, we access the [b]Println[/b]() function of the "[b]fmt[/b]" package, which is used to generate the output:[code format="go" codeId="3291"]package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
[b]    fmt.Println("Hello, World!")[/b]
}[/code]
The [b]Println[/b]() is an exported name, which is why it starts with a capital letter. 
[note]We provide the output we want to generate inside the parentheses enclosed in quotes.[/note]

content.text:
每个包(`package`)中都有**可导出**的变量或函数，你可以在导入后访问它们。

在**Go**中，如果一个变量名或函数名是以**大写字母**开头的，那么它就是可导出的。

你可以使用`包名.导出的对象名`来访问导出的对象。

> 此处的对象，就是包里面的某个变量、函数 或 常量等等。

在下面例子中，我们访问了**fmt**包的**Println**()函数，用来输出内容：
content.text_html:
Each package has exported names, which you can access after importing them.

In Go, a name is exported if it begins with a capital letter. You can access the exported names using the package name, a dot, and the exported name.

In our case, we access the Println() function of the "fmt" package, which is used to generate the output:

每个包都有导出的名称，你可以在导入后访问它们。

在围棋中，如果一个名字是以大写字母开头的，那么它就是导出的。 你可以使用包的名称、一个点和导出的名称来访问导出的名称。

在我们的例子中，我们访问了 "fmt"包的Println()函数，它被用来生成输出。

content.text: `Println()`是可以被**导出的**，因为以大写字母`P`开头。
content.text_html:
The Println() is an exported name, which is why it starts with a capital letter.

Println()是一个导出的名称，这就是为什么它以大写字母开头。

content.text: 我们在括号`()`内提供想要输出的内容。
content.text_html:
We provide the output we want to generate inside the parentheses enclosed in quotes.

我们在引号中的括号内提供我们想要生成的输出。

[s0l0!-header][h1]Imports[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Similar to other programming languages such as Java or C++, [b]func main()[/b] is the entry point of our program. It is the function that gets executed when we run our program.

Here is our code which generates a text output:[code format="go" codeId="3292"]package main

import "fmt"

[b]func main() {
    fmt.Println("Hello, World!")
}[/b]
 [/code]
You can see that the code:
1. defines the [b]main[/b] package
2. imports the "[b]fmt[/b]" package used for output
3. defines the [b]main[/b]() function.
4. Uses the [b]Println[/b]() function of the [b]fmt[/b] package to generate the desired output. 

[note]We will learn more about functions in the coming modules.[/note]
